body:
Source: GitHub issue #657 (bug, P1-high, area:mutation). Re-verified on main @ 982adee7: packages/hollow-test/bin/hollow-test.mjs:800-812. `starved` (diff-derived selected files that were never attempted because buildFileTargets() round-robin gave them quota 0) triggers only a `console.warn` and the run falls through to `pass()` at line 855 — exit 0 — as long as whatever mutants DID run were killed. Repro from the issue: `--max 1` against 3 changed files (only 1 covered by tests) prints `hollow-test: 2 selected file(s) received no mutation budget and were NOT prosecuted: src/b.mjs, src/c.mjs` on stderr, then `All mutants killed — coverage gate passes`, EXIT=0 — even though b.mjs and c.mjs have zero tests and were never mutated at all. CI keys on the exit code; the warning is invisible there.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/hollow-test`: bin/hollow-test.mjs is the CLI entry and holds ALL the logic in this ticket (buildFileTargets call at line 516, the starved-EXPLICIT-target fail-closed check at lines 518-533, the starved-DIFF-DERIVED-file warn-only check at lines 795-812, survivors/pass/opError at the bottom). lib/targets.mjs holds buildFileTargets() (the round-robin budget allocator) and isMutableSource — read it to understand `quota`, do not change its allocation algorithm. lib/runner.mjs and lib/report.mjs are mutant-execution/reporting machinery, unrelated to this ticket. lib/inflight.mjs (SIGINT recovery) is unrelated. Tests: `npm test -w packages/hollow-test` from the worktree root.

EXISTING PRECEDENT IN THE SAME FILE (lines 518-533): when an EXPLICIT --target/--rails file gets quota 0, hollow-test already calls `opError(...)` (operational error, non-zero exit) rather than warning — this ticket makes the DIFF-DERIVED case (lines 805-812) match that same treatment, closing the inconsistency the issue names directly ("matching how zero-mutant explicit targets already fail closed"). The code comment at lines 793-799 currently documents the warn-only behaviour as deliberate, citing issues #70/#41/#35 for the budget-sharing design (explicit targets get priority, diff-derived files share what's left) — that budget-SHARING design is unchanged by this ticket; only the OUTCOME when sharing leaves a file at zero changes, from silent-pass to fail-closed. Update that comment to explain the new behaviour instead of the old one.

CONSUMER: scripts/mutation-gate.mjs spawns this bin (line 457) and passes through `result.status` verbatim as its own exit code (line 484: `process.exit(typeof result.status === 'number' ? result.status : 1)`), distinguishing only status 2 ("mutant survived") for extra guidance text — it does not special-case any other non-zero status, so a new exit 1 here already propagates correctly with no change needed in mutation-gate.mjs itself. Run its test scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs as a consumer regression check regardless.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. When `starved.length > 0` (hollow-test.mjs:807, diff-derived files with quota 0 that were never attempted), call `opError` with a message naming the starved file(s) and instructing to raise --max (reuse the existing warning's wording as the message body) INSTEAD OF `console.warn` — exit code follows whatever `opError` already uses elsewhere in this file (operational error, exit 1; confirm by reading opError's definition, do not assume).
2. `--json` mode: same fail-closed decision: `opError`/exit path must still emit the JSON error shape existing operational errors use in `--json` mode elsewhere in this file (see how the `unchecked` block at line 823-830 or the all-invalid block at 833-844 splits `useJson` vs human text) — do not print a plain warning to stdout under `--json`.
3. `noMutableLines` (hollow-test.mjs:806, 813-818 — files with budget but no mutable lines, e.g. comment/import-only diffs) is UNCHANGED: stays a warning, stays non-fatal — this is not a starvation case, it is a correct "nothing to mutate" result, and the issue does not ask for it to change.
4. Documentation: update `packages/hollow-test/README.md` and hand-edit the same statement into `docs/tools/hollow-test.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/hollow-test.mdx` (mirrors — never regenerate) describing the new fail-closed behaviour and how to raise --max in response.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Reproduce the issue's exact repro (3 changed files, only 1 covered, `--max 1`) end-to-end: the run now exits non-zero and neither prints "All mutants killed — coverage gate passes" nor produces a JSON success shape. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/starved-budget.test.mjs`
- AC2 A run where every selected file DOES receive nonzero quota (`--max` sized to cover all files) is unaffected: exits 0 on all-killed exactly as today. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/starved-budget.test.mjs`
- AC3 `noMutableLines` files (budget given, but the hunk has no mutable code) still only warn and do not fail the gate on their own. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/starved-budget.test.mjs`
- AC4 `--json` mode on the starved case emits the same error/exit-code contract as other operational errors in this file, not the success JSON shape. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/starved-budget.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite green, INCLUDING diff-zero-mutants.test.mjs and hollow-test.test.mjs — if either pins the old warn-and-pass starved behaviour, rewrite the pinned assertion and say so plainly in the PR body (do not silently delete a case). verify: `npm test -w packages/hollow-test`
- AC6 mutation-gate.mjs's own consumer test still passes (it treats hollow-test's exit code pass-through generically, so this should need no code change there — confirm, don't assume). verify: `node --test scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs`
- AC7 Docs updated in all three places. verify: `grep -c "raise --max\|--max" packages/hollow-test/README.md docs/tools/hollow-test.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/hollow-test.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC8 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: buildFileTargets()'s round-robin allocation algorithm itself (lib/targets.mjs) — not touched, only the OUTCOME of a zero-quota diff-derived file; the explicit-target starvation path (lines 518-533), already fail-closed, unchanged; auto-raising the budget (the issue's alternative recommendation) — this ticket implements the exit-1 option only.
title: hollow-test: a diff-derived selected file starved of mutation budget must fail the gate, not warn and pass
